content_of_post_to_answer: How do I stop overthinking small mistakes or past phases in my life that no longer matter?
answer: Overthinking past mistakes often comes from treating memory as a courtroom where every old decision is still on trial. A more useful question is not “Was I wrong?” but “What did that version of me know, feel, and have available at that time?” Growth requires updating your view of the past, not repeatedly punishing an outdated version of yourself. Reflection creates learning; replay creates a habit of self-judgment. The past deserves understanding, not a lifetime sentence.
